findings.location: comment[fraction identifier], rows for QHF05032-36 (11-15) and QHF2_02250-02260 (1-10)
findings.message: Fraction identifiers are acquisition-order guesses. The ordering between the two file-name series (QHF05xxx vs QHF2_xxxxx) is arbitrary, and the paper says non-modified peptides were fractionated by HILIC plus high-pH, so a single 1-15 sequence is not supported. Phospho files 1-7 are similarly based only on filename order.
findings.evidence: WorkflowInputFiles lists files only; paper Methods give no per-file fraction assignment; manifest limitation admits 'true HILIC/high-pH fraction order ... not stated'.
findings.correction: Use a value the evidence supports (e.g. mark not available/derive only what is documented, or provide a source mapping file->fraction), and state the basis; do not present invented ordering as fact.

findings.message: Phospho and non-modified sets are the same 6 TMT channels from one mix (paper: samples labeled, pooled 1:1, then enriched), yet get separate source names (12 sources).
findings.evidence: Paper Methods; msf both define [126]-[131] with same factor mapping.
findings.correction: Consider sharing source names across enrichment fractions.
